g.text: BSH-FireAlarm Node — Complete Fritzing Wiring & Schematic
GPIO / SPI / I2C / PWM / ADC Signals
1. Pull Station (GPIO 4): Bench uses 3-pin Keyestudio Button Module (onboard pull-up, plain INPUT, active-LOW). Docs also list 2-pin button w/ INPUT_PULLUP.
2. Gas Sensor (MQ-9 Gas Sensor (Doc: MQ-2)): AO -> GPIO 34 (ADC1), DO -> GPIO 19 (wired for future use, unused by firmware), VCC -> 5V (VIN). Verify AO <= 3.3V (add 1k/2k divider if >3.3V).
3. Flame Sensor (LM393): D0 -> GPIO 18 (active-LOW), VCC -> 3.3V (or 5V per module rating). RGB LED: R=GPIO 25, G=GPIO 26, B=GPIO 27 via 3x 220 ohm; Buzzer: GPIO 23.
